facts.claim: 三个发布preload均只有一处未被局部require绑定遮蔽的require("electron")调用。词法绑定匹配的普通CallExpression共48处（30/17/1）；该统计不覆盖OptionalCallExpression、NewExpression或任意别名传播，不代表完整Electron能力面。
facts.method: complete-program Babel AST, lexical-binding joins and bounded frozen-source review

facts.claim: bootstrap gT以moduleDir拼接preload.js并作为U导出；main从对应CJS导入调用g.U，V.preloadPath经M1e传入y1e options，createWindow把该路径放入BrowserWindow的webPreferences。源码显式contextIsolation=true、nodeIntegration=false；该对象未显式给出sandbox，不推断实际默认值。
facts.method: complete-program Babel AST, lexical-binding joins and bounded frozen-source review

facts.claim: 主桥接用contextBridge暴露codexWindowType及包含22项属性的electronBridge；Sentry命名空间在另一个受try/catch保护的条件分支中暴露。22项是该对象属性分母，不包含窗口message通道及Sentry接口，也不证明全部主进程处理已运行。
facts.method: complete-program Babel AST, lexical-binding joins and bounded frozen-source review

facts.claim: preload启动有四次同步IPC读取：Sentry初始化元数据、build flavor、共享对象快照和系统主题。只有共享快照在此处有nullish空对象回退。首次侧栏bootstrap另行惰性同步读取；返回undefined时下次仍会读取。
facts.method: complete-program Babel AST, lexical-binding joins and bounded frozen-source review

facts.claim: worker订阅使用每worker的Set和listener Map；最后一个callback删除后移除对应IPC listener。主题回调Set返回删除函数；共享快照在本地shared-object-set发送前乐观更新，收到shared-object-updated时再次更新，undefined值删除键。
facts.method: complete-program Babel AST, lexical-binding joins and bounded frozen-source review

facts.claim: 主preload保留message-for-view转发、MCP host转移端口、PIP decoder/frame生命周期与connect-app-host窗口message入口；这些能力不属于22个对象属性的完整分母。connect-app-host复用既有绑定分析，外部端口接收方和原生交付仍待运行验证。
facts.method: complete-program Babel AST, lexical-binding joins and bounded frozen-source review

facts.claim: main的JJ绑定拼接browser-page-preload.js，并以preloadPath传给ICe。ICe的同一参数h交给LCe；LCe设置session/preload后调用cU。cU移除guest传入的allowpopups/disablewebsecurity/webpreferences并显式设sandbox/contextIsolation/webSecurity=true和Node集成=false等参数。

facts.claim: 选定window.open handler还通过输入e.browserPagePreloadPath设置overrideBrowserWindowOptions，并要求能adopt的真实WebContents。getPageLifecycleHelpers输出中存在同名字段JJ；本批没有把整个helper对象到该局部参数的所有中间调用都证明为同一对象，不能以字段同名补齐该数据流。

facts.claim: 浏览器preload存在三处词法匹配的contextBridge.executeInMainWorld调用；DS先登记IPC，再对安全顶层窗口读取annotation policy。webMCP的ZS有独立同步policy读取，未套用DS的安全顶层条件；toolchange订阅在非persisted pagehide移除。可选webFrame zoom调用在普通CallExpression计数之外。

facts.claim: sandbox-preload校验协议、host及子域、无端口/凭据、skybridge路径查询、当前origin和initId；要求12个port并选取7个可选port。shape检查只要求postMessage/start函数。一次性标志在ipcRenderer.postMessage前置true，未在此代码中设置失败回退；传输选中的port及replyPort。

facts.claim: main的Ese will-attach回调在partition/source/initId/view实例等检查后设置sandbox-preload.js和明确的sandbox/contextIsolation/webSecurity参数。_se读取与赋值由同一program binding解析；Ese由createWindow在相应窗口条件下安装。既有MCP入口合同继续负责更广用户流程，不新增模式排除。
facts.method: complete-program Babel AST, lexical-binding joins and bounded frozen-source review

facts.claim: bootstrap中Lx的唯一选定调用来自PreloadInjection集成：Classic位、app ready、FS返回绝对路径且existsSync成功后，对getSessions逐一登记。FS尝试解析../../preload/default.js；Lx优先registerPreloadScript({type:frame,filePath})，否则getPreloads后setPreloads前置路径。这是单独的Sentry注入线索，不能当作应用preload.js的加载链；未证明该分支实际成功。
facts.method: complete-program Babel AST, lexical-binding joins and bounded frozen-source review

buildDecisions.decision: Create three independent preload build entry targets with stable emitted names. Keep app-host-bridge.ts, browser-preload/annotation/* and existing desktop-transport ownership paths; do not split each controller into a package or duplicate broad source witnesses.
buildDecisions.qualification: maintenance design; no client files generated

buildDecisions.decision: Produce one CommonJS-compatible bundle per entry, with dynamic first-party imports resolved within that entry build and no unqualified runtime chunk require. Keep electron external because the runtime supplies it. Bundle reachable pure-JS packages from the new exact lock; do not write vendor implementation into maintained source.
buildDecisions.qualification: build policy; actual target bundler/configuration and package compatibility remain unbuilt

buildDecisions.decision: Treat preload outputs as named resources resolved from the independent packaged application. Recreate all three path consumers and individual load/error attribution. Keep SDK session injection distinct from application webPreferences injection.
buildDecisions.qualification: required build/packaging behavior, not a validated clean build

buildDecisions.decision: Keep the 22-property app bridge separate from browser page main-world execution and MCP port initialization. Restore startup handler ordering, worker/theme subscriptions, snapshot semantics and transferred-port lifecycles without exposing ipcRenderer or _linkedBinding as a general escape.
buildDecisions.qualification: source-derived interface responsibilities; external effects still unverified

buildDecisions.decision: Qualify package imports against saved emitted contracts, then lock the newly selected versions/integrities independently of the baseline version evidence. React/ReactDOM self-report, Sentry names and mixed browser bundle ranges do not permit whole-file first-party code generation.
buildDecisions.qualification: dependency adoption decision; package substitution qualification remains open

buildDecisions.decision: Use the selected provider Chromium/Node/bridge contract to set compile targets and types. Preserve explicit guest preferences and determine app-window sandbox defaults; require real executeInMainWorld/port delivery/ABI behavior before integration acceptance. Reuse named native gaps rather than restarting provider tracing from these entries.
buildDecisions.qualification: provider and product integration gates remain open

acceptanceGates.expected: Three declared single-entry bundles and required assets are emitted into the new application; no target-source evaluation is needed for source preparation.

Inspect generated imports/requires against the selected sandbox loader map; electron is provider-supplied, JS packages come from the new integrity lock, native/Node capabilities remain explicit boundaries.
Verify four startup synchronous handlers and lazy sidebar handler exist before load, exact bridge types, shared snapshot updates, worker/theme unsubscribe and existing app-host transfer behavior.

Verify admitted attach preferences, window.open preload forwarding object chain, all three executeInMainWorld functions under the selected provider, annotation/webMCP policy gates and pagehide cleanup.
